name: simple-gpt-mcp
description: A small stdio MCP server for OpenAI conversations with durable sessions and recovery

scripts.test: pnpm run build && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/*.test.ts
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run test:coverage
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm run build && node --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include=src/*.ts --test-coverage-exclude=src/index.ts --test-coverage-lines=80 --test-coverage-branches=75 --test-coverage-functions=80 --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/*.test.ts
